label: Original draft
note: The design as first written: conventional cell density and a growing culture.

label: Hpx- knockout
note: Catalase/peroxidase triple knockout. Raises resting cytoplasmic H2O2 above the OxyR half-activation point, so the reporter starts switched on and the fold gets worse.

label: Recommended
note: Low cell density, non-growing cells, a 60-minute read, creatinine normalised.

label: Periplasmic display
note: Enzyme displayed in the periplasm; the effective loading per litre of assay is capped by periplasmic volume.

label: Real urine
note: Adds 2 uM of cross-reactive polyamines and a matrix peroxide sink. The selectivity of 100 is an assumption: none has been measured for this enzyme.
